claims.evidence: No spec sticker or nameplate visible on panel back in the photo; wattage cannot be read.
Cell grid pattern is visible but individual cell count cannot be confirmed from the image.
No manufacturer label, logo, or country-of-origin marking visible in the photo.
Panels appear stacked outdoors without packaging, consistent with used stock, but no visible wear, dust pattern, or test result confirms actual usage or condition.

risks.risk: Actual wattage rating may be lower than claimed, since no nameplate/sticker is visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/sticker showing rated wattage, voltage, and current
risks.if_unproven: priced as lowest plausible wattage tier for panels of this visible size

risks.risk: Cell count and panel type (mono/poly, half-cut etc.) cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Clear daylight close-up of the cell grid or the rear spec label
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unbranded panel, not premium Canadian-cell type

risks.risk: Hidden microcracks, hotspots, or degraded output from used panels
risks.proof: A clip showing a multimeter or clamp meter reading open-circuit voltage/current under sunlight, or an electroluminescence/crack-check photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-tested used panel, worst-case reduced output

risks.risk: Number of panels actually included in this sale is unclear (several are shown stacked)
risks.proof: Seller confirmation photo with panels laid out and counted, or a video panning across all units for sale
risks.if_unproven: priced per single panel only, not as a bundle

risks.risk: Mounting cart/trolley may or may not be included
risks.proof: Seller statement plus a photo showing the cart tagged or set aside as included
risks.if_unproven: priced as panel only, cart excluded

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/spec sticker on each panel (wattage, voltage, cell count, brand)
A video/photo of a multimeter test under sunlight showing open-circuit voltage and current output
A clear photo of the full set of panels being sold, laid flat and counted
Confirmation (photo) on whether the cart/trolley is part of the sale
response.reason: The witness confirms these are solar panels, so pricing is possible, but with no visible spec label or output test, all wattage, cell-count, and origin claims are unverifiable and must be priced at worst case.
